question: Identify the driver who had the most accidents in the history of the European Grand Prix and return their full name, nationality, and introduction URL. Only consider drivers who also recorded a fastest lap time ranked in the top 10 during any European Grand Prix race.

prediction.sql:
WITH accident_counts AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id, COUNT(*) AS accident_count
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    JOIN status s ON r.XCL_090 = s.XCL_093
    WHERE ra.XCL_069 = 'European Grand Prix'
      AND s.XCL_094 = 'Accident'
    GROUP BY r.XCL_075
),
fastest_lap_qualified AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.XCL_075 AS driver_id
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    WHERE ra.XCL_069 = 'European Grand Prix'
      AND r.XCL_087 IS NOT NULL
      AND r.XCL_087 <= 10
)
SELECT d.XCL_038, d.XCL_039, d.XCL_041, d.XCL_042
FROM drivers d
JOIN accident_counts ac ON d.XCL_034 = ac.driver_id
JOIN fastest_lap_qualified flq ON d.XCL_034 = flq.driver_id
ORDER BY ac.accident_count DESC
LIMIT 1
